SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.92

Train the reader: after correcting what the reader filled in, teach it for next time. The vendor, due date, which figure is the amount, the account and class, the customer and a memo can each be set for one vendor, account or printed name, or for every document. A plain-words note goes to Claude with each matching document.
The app offers “Learn this for next time?” after a corrected save.
Rules are listed under Lists → What the reader learned.
Invoice reader (from beta.91): the amount includes GCT, the due date is worked out from terms like “7 Day Credit”, and more vendors are recognised.
